description: Get an experiment's videos by pair and its paired results per provider for a metrics window (default 7d): per-pair views/likes/comments/average view duration, wins per variant, sign-test pValue and a label — pending (nothing to compare), indicative (not proven: too few pairs or not all pairs in) or clear (every target pair decided and p < 0.05). Never call a variant the winner unless the label is clear.
name: get_experiment_results
